typeBlock.description: This GDDI type is used to carry CCSDS Space Packets, Encapsulation Packets, or User-formatted Service Data Units of variable-length (such as CCSDS UT_SDUs for CFDP) in the GDDI payload with corresponding metadata used by recipients to process the data. This message type supports the case where different CCSDS MAP SDU data formats are required to be multiplexed by a CCSDS Data Link service from a single interface point. These messages are typically transferred between C2 and FEP applications for uplink commanding, downlink telemetry, and bi-directional CFDP or payload data. An example is a downlink CCSDS Space Packet extracted from a CCSDS TM/AOS/USLP Data Link sent from a FEP to a C2 application.

tlv.description: The type of service data unit being carried by this 'CCSDS MAP SDU' (0: CCSDS Packet, 1: User Data), where 'CCSDS Packet' indicates the GDDI payload can contain either a CCSDS Space Packet or CCSDS Encapsulation Packet, and 'User Data' indicates the GDDI payload contains a User-formatted Service Data Unit. The PVN metadata in this type indicates if the 'CCSDS Packet' data is a CCSDS Space or Encapsulation Packet. The PVN also indicates what packet version (Space or Encapsulation) the 'User Data' is to be encapsulated into, or was extractd from. Both SDU Types can be fixed or variable-length data. (Default: 0)

Packet Version Number (1: CCSDS Space Packet, 8: CCSDS Encapsulation Packet) used as described in the 'SDU Type' metadata. These are CCSDS authorized PVN values per http://sanaregistry.org/r/packet_version_number/packet_version_number.html (Default: 1)
Space Craft ID associated with this 'CCSDS MAP SDU'. CCSDS TC and TM max SCID is 1023. CCSDS AOS max SCID is 255. CCSDS USLP max SCID is 65535. (Default: 0)
Virtual Channel ID associated with this 'CCSDS MAP SDU'. CCSDS TC, AOS, and USLP max VCID is 63. CCSDS TM max VCID is 7. (Default: 0)

Multiplexer Access Point ID associated with this 'CCSDS MAP SDU'. For TC this is a 6-bit field in the Segment Header of the Frame Data Unit within the overall TC transfer frame. The TC Segment Header is required for any Virtual Channel which has more than one MAP or which transfers SDUs larger than permitted in a single Transfer Frame, so MAPID may not be needed for VCP or VCA channels. For USLP this is a 4-bit field in the Primary Header of all Transfer Frames used for MAP services. When only one MAP exists (or for USLP VCP, VCA, OCF, VCF, MCF, and Insert services), the MAPID is set to a constant value for all data on that Virtual Channel. (Default: 0)

Application Process ID associated with this 'CCSDS MAP SDU'. CCSDS max APID is 2047. Applicable when PVN is 'CCSDS Space Packet'. Use the Default value for PVNs other than 'CCSDS Space Packet'. (Default: 65535)
Source Sequence Count per APID. Applicable when PVN is 'CCSDS Space Packet'. (Default: 0)

Quality of Service (0: Sequence Controlled, 1: Expedited) applicable to CCSDS TC and USLP in the uplink direction, where the receiving TC or USLP Data Link that encapsulates this 'CCSDS MAP SDU' sets the appropriate Bypass/Sequence Control Flag in the transfer frame header, indicating the QoS to the spacecraft. The 'Sequence Controlled' QoS specifies that the uplink frame is subject to the COP-1 Frame Acceptance Checks of the FARM in the spacecraft. The Expedited QoS specifies that the uplink frame bypasses these Frame Acceptance Checks in the spacecraft. (Default: 1)
Timestamp for this 'CCSDS MAP SDU', representing the number of non-leap seconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on 1 January 1970. (Default: 0)
The number of picoseconds representing the fractional portion of the 'Timestamp Seconds' metadata. (Default: 0)

Indicates if an error was detected in the downlink path. True indicates this 'CCSDS MAP SDU' contains sequence, parse, frame, decoding, and/or header errors from underlying CCSDS data link, frame processing, or Block FEC decoding functions. False indicates no errors detected, or this is an uplink 'CCSDS MAP SDU' that has not yet been exposed to error conditions of the transmit path, e.g. a 'CCSDS MAP SDU' being sent from a C2 application to a FEP application. (Default: false)
